skills.name: Grand Resonance

description.raw: Dunlingr releases a shockwave covering the frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), dealing 4 hits of 40% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage each to enemies within. If the Bell of Order is set to Spellbind, Dunlingr reduces the enemies' ATK SPD by an extra 60 for 4s If the Bell of Order is set to Curelock, Dunlingr deals extra damage equal to 3% of the enemies' lost HP, up to 30% of his own ATK.
active: Dunlingr releases a shockwave covering the frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), dealing 4 hits of 40% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage each to enemies within.

If the Bell of Order is set to Spellbind, Dunlingr reduces the enemies' ATK SPD by an extra 60 for 4s If the Bell of Order is set to Curelock, Dunlingr deals extra damage equal to 3% of the enemies' lost HP, up to 30% of his own ATK.

skills.description_lite: Dunlingr deals damage to enemies in front of him and applies additional effects based on the specified order he has set.

skills.name: Harmonic Soundwall

description.raw: If the Bell of Order is set to Spellbind, Dunlingr gains a shield that absorbs 130% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage whenever an enemy casts their Ultimate, lasting until the battle ends. If the Bell of Order is set to Curelock, Dunlingr gains a shield that absorbs 130% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage each time he loses 20% of his max HP, lasting until the battle ends.
